# NTopo source and adaptation

`upstream/` is an unmodified source snapshot from
https://github.com/JonasZehn/ntopo at commit
`d3e17ca4cfb1d7a71c4c4f0c965cfcdc67d53fa9`.

The original license is `upstream/LICENSE`. `PINNED_SOURCE.json` records file
hashes. `nonlinear_worker.py` is HGTO's disclosed Neo-Hookean adaptation,
not part of the upstream release. See `NONLINEAR_ADAPTATION.md` and the
[baseline instructions](../../docs/baselines.md).
